description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Pride], [Damage Cap +10000], [Linked Materia Mode (Wind, Holy)], [Dream Herald Mode], [Dream Herald Quick Cast] and [Dream Herald Critical Damage +50%] to the user

description.name: Awoken Pride
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Holy] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: Dream Herald Mode
description.text: Grants [Dream Herald Wind Ability +15/30/50% Boost]/[Dream Herald Holy Ability +15/30/50% Boost] after using 1/2/3+ Wind or Holy abilities if the triggering ability deals Wind/Holy damage

description.name: Dream Herald Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, removed if the character hasn't [Dream Herald Mode]

description.name: Dream Herald Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), removed if the character hasn't [Dream Herald Mode]
